title: Section-normalized ordinary pro-etale pullback composition
statement:
Let $Z\xrightarrow{k}Y\xrightarrow{h}X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R,S,T$ be sheaves of commutative rings on $X,Y,Z$ and let $c:h^{-1}R\xrightarrow{\sim}S$, $d:k^{-1}S\xrightarrow{\sim}T$ be coefficient identifications [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use the canonical composite identification $c_{kh}$ [def-sfb-proetale-composite-coefficients] and the normalized module pullback/direct-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define
$$a:(hk)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}k^*h^*$$
to be the unique natural isomorphism whose conjugate under the composite adjunction $k^*h^*\dashv h_*k_*$ and $(hk)^*\dashv(hk)_*$ is the direct-image comparison $b:h_*k_*\xrightarrow{\sim}(hk)_*$. It is fixed on every module sheaf $N$ on $Z$, every object $W$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, and every section $m\in N(Z\times_Y(Y\times_XW))$ by
$$b_N(W)(m)=N(p_W)(m),$$
where $p_W:Z\times_XW\xrightarrow{\sim}Z\times_Y(Y\times_XW)$ is the canonical fibre-product pasting isomorphism. Thus this definition uses the prescribed adjunctions and pasting, not an arbitrary comparison.
